description: Run one Wai calculator by its id with its input keys and values. Numbers are computed by Wai's code, so the figures are exact for the given inputs; percentages as the key name says. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call. Typical questions: "LCOE of a 20 MW solar plant with 1750 kWh/kWp, capex 650 €/kW and 7 % WACC"; "IRR, NPV and payback of a 5 MW solar project selling at 65 €/MWh"; "BESS revenue stacking for a 50 MW / 400 MWh battery: arbitrage, FCR and aFRR"; "Cable size and voltage drop for 630 A over 150 m at 0.4 kV, copper XLPE".
name: wai_calculate
title: Run a Wai calculator
